claims.statement: PSE states that MojeIRE gives customers, prosumers, and generators access to their data, including interval data where available, and lets them grant selected firms or organizations access for tailored offers.

contrary_evidence: MojeIRE access is free and consumers can analyze or export their own data; migration timing varies by DSO, so a broker must add decision value beyond access.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: customer-permitted pre/post retrofit outcomes improve technology and tariff models without owning the raw CSIRE data
fingerprint.customer: Polish renewable installers, ESCOs, lenders, and their consenting household or SME prospects
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: renewable installers embed a consent link between lead qualification and site visit
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: consent workflow, interval-data normalization, counterfactual scenarios, uncertainty bands, and quote-ready export
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the installer or financier pays when the customer-authorized underwriting packet is generated
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a customer requests a retrofit or tariff offer but lacks a trustworthy interval-data baseline

founder_fit: Exceptional data-science and family-business fit; a small authorized pilot can measure conversion while respecting revocable customer control.
risks: Consent or derived-data misuse would destroy trust.
Savings estimates could be treated as guarantees.

structure.control_point: the customer's revocable CSIRE data grant and normalized savings case before installer quoting and finance approval
structure.critical_dependency: OIRE access agreements, customer consent flows, DSO migration into CSIRE, and permission to deliver derived analytics

thesis: Use customer-granted access to Polish CSIRE interval and contract data to produce equipment-neutral solar, storage, heat-pump, tariff, and flexibility scenarios before a retrofit quote. The customer controls consent; installers pay only for a decision-ready, authorized opportunity packet. All commercial numbers, including capital_required_pln, are unvalidated hypotheses.
title: CSIRE-Consented Retrofit Underwriting Broker
uncertainties: Professional-user eligibility and integration effort need confirmation with OIRE.
Installer conversion lift and paid willingness are unvalidated.
